body:
Indeed, this is issue exists in all branches up to current master.
Even though we return LONG as the type of the column, the `count(distinct <field_name>)` is extracted from the result of the HyperLogLog used under the hood for the distinct counts which is a Double.

rename.to: SQL: COUNT(DISTINCT(field)) returns with decimal instead of long

issue.title: SQL: Fix result values for COUNT(DISTINCT ...)

repository.name: elasticsearch

issue.body:
Previously, we extracted the result of the `CardinalityAgg` as `double`
which resulted in double values shown in the REST response, even though
the type of the corresponding column for `COUNT(DISTINCT <field_name>)`
was showing `long`. This affected only the REST interface of SQL and not
the JDBC/ODBC drivers. e.g.: `152.0` instead of `152`

Extract a long value instead of a double.

Fixes: #58097
